title: A Bavarian servant at Wardein to Duke Ludwig of Bavaria, 14 March 1537, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.257-259 (DECODE R9414; catalogue 162)

documents.shelfmark: BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.257-259 (DECODE R9414)

plaintext.source: Gloss over P1 l.6-8; clear opening, date and address; key rebuilt here.

transcription.notes: transcription_v2.txt, one char per sign, '?' blots counted as signs.

system.summary: Homophonic sign alphabet 'G' (own sign set, 42 signs measured), German, with a few word signs (large Ψ, swash X, K) and an unkeyed barred ∂; clear opening, date and address.
system.sibling_key: none fits: R9369 (Augurelio 1531), the System A′ key and Łaski's System B tested, no match

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear gloss over P1 l.6-8; no edition found (web search 22 Sept 2026).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie; the target was assigned by the user. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: DECODE images of R9414 (with R9403, R9415 of catalogue 162) and neighbours R9404-R9407, R9418-R9422 fetched with the cookie
R9369 (Augurelio's 1531 key) and the System A′ key tested on R9414 (system G)
R9414 transcribed (v1, then v2 on line-third crops)
R9414 P1 l.6-8 gloss gave the first values of system G
R9414 annealing and de-1500s beam (beam2.py) - about 50% read
R9414 three visual passes over every line (cp12 logs): 77.1% then 91.3%
gapfill.py one-edit lexicon search over unread R9414 words
Web search for the Zápolya letters to the Bavarian dukes, Łaski, Augurelio, Acta Tomiciana: no edition

Push-to-95% pass: every unread R9414 word set beside its raw decrypt (decrypt_v2, cp12/dec_*_new) and resolved only where the decrypt itself spells the word: 'Lunden' (P1.34, the Archbishop of Lund, Charles V's negotiator with King John), 'feind' (P3.04), 'befelch' (P2.17), 'handstain' (P4.34, mining term); remaining gaps not supported by the decrypt left unread

Full-resolution re-transcription of every non-code R9414 gap (r9414/pass4.txt); accepted 'ist', 'auch er', 'wut', 'sag wan', 'seiner', 'red'; withdrew 'handstain'; found an unkeyed barred-d sign at five gaps and the Psi code at P1.18/P1.25

Joint LM scoring (de-1500s) of the unkeyed barred-d sign over its five R9414 places, all letters and 23 digraphs/short words, plus the large Psi word sign (proposed 'Mt.'); siblings R9403, R9415, System B key and sperantio1534 checked for both signs

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3869 tokens, 33 types, de-1500s order 4: reading -2.249 per letter; random keys -6.676 (z 6.2); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.639 (mean -3.69, z 54.4); annealer on the real text -2.399. Verdict: pass.

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591b (catalogue 162), whose other two letters are in Łaski's System B (R9403, now with the other System B letters in kaa4591b) and system L (R9415, moved to sperantio1534). Profile, validation and measure carried over: they were already R9414's alone.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.971; polyphony 0.043; 746 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.399

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key of a new homophonic alphabet was seeded from the contemporary interlinear gloss over P1 l.6-8 and completed by annealing and beam search with the de-1500s model, then checked in four passes against the images.
outcome.fraction_read_source: words of the ciphered runs: r9414/count_v2.py reading_v5.txt 958/1039; [..] counted unread
outcome.notes: Under the read bar at 92.2%; the key has ambiguous homophones (alternatives in alt_v2.txt, cp12/alt_p12.txt). The barred ∂ is probably a null or mark; Ψ fits Mt. in four of six places, not counted.

gaps.item: code signs Ψ, swash X, K (~10 words)
gaps.detail: word signs with no key in the volume or on DECODE
